Welfare checks on stores up upper Queen St complete. No issues. Headed to Aotea Sq to maintain visible presence.
Conducted a thorough sweep of Aotea Sq. All clear. Headed to Victoria St via Federal St.
Federal St all clear. Standing by Victoria St maintaining security presence.
Victoria St West all clear. Headed down Victoria St to commence patrols up Lorne St.
Welfare checks on Lorne St complete. Standing by maintaining visible presence.
Arrived at upper Queen St. No issues or calls to report. Maintaining security presence till further notice.
Leaving standby area. No issues to report.
Heading back up Victoria St West.
Arrived at corner of Albert St / Victoria St West; standing by for any nearby response calls and maintaining security presence.
Morning shift informed us for route changeover. Team 2 covering lower CBD.
Heading down Albert St; welfare check Albert Mart. All clear.
Arrived at lower Albert St; welfare check Woolworths / Aotea Gifts. All clear.
Arrived at Reign N Pour; welfare check. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete. All clear. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Response call from Hallensteins requesting assistance with a possible theft in store; heading there now.
Arrived at store; no issues to report as the vagrant had already taken leave and had not taken anything. Continuing patrol.

Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq sweep complete. All clear.
Leaving standby area; no further issues. Heading back to HQ for debrief with morning shift before stand down.

Departing from Specsavers as there were no escalated matters to report. Resuming patrol on lower Queen St.

Full sweep Commercial Bay clear; welfare check clear. Heading to Albert St.

Welfare sweep on the Cathedral clear.
Commencing welfare sweeps up Victoria St West.
Welfare sweep on all stores up Victoria St West complete. No issues. Crossing over to Federal St.
Queen St all clear. Headed back to HQ taking our 30-minute break.
Break completed; equipment accounted for and handover completed. Team 2 standing down.

Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.

Arrived at Lorne St; maintaining visible presence while awaiting response requests.

Arrived back at HQ; handover to night shift. Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
